name: Exp_Iin_MA_Signal
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the Iin_MA_Signal custom indicator, which generates buy and sell signals using moving average crossover logic. It automatically opens positions in the direction of the detected trend and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, executing trades when the indicator's signal conditions are met.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于Iin_MA_Signal自定义指标的趋势跟踪专家顾问，通过均线交叉逻辑生成买卖信号。它在检测到趋势方向时自动开仓，并使用可配置的止损和止盈水平管理交易。该EA系统化运行，无需手动干预，在指标信号条件满足时执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于移动平均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，利用Iin_MA_Signal指标判断趋势方向。入场条件为当指标发出买入信号（快均线上穿慢均线）时开多单，发出卖出信号（快均线下穿慢均线）时开空单。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈参数，当价格触及止损或止盈水平时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过InpLots参数设定每笔交易的手数大小。资金管理方面没有动态仓位调整或风险百分比计算，完全依赖用户手动设定合理的交易量。策略在趋势行情中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能因频繁的均线交叉信号而产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on moving average crossovers, using the Iin_MA_Signal indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the indicator emits a bullish signal (fast MA crossing above slow MA) and a sell when it emits a bearish signal (fast MA crossing below slow MA). Exit conditions rely on pre-configured stop loss and take profit parameters, closing positions when price reaches either level. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume via the InpLots parameter. Money management lacks dynamic position adjustment or risk percentage calculation, depending entirely on the user to manually set a reasonable trade size. The strategy performs well in trending markets but may generate consecutive losses in ranging markets due to frequent MA crossover whipsaws.

parameters.name: InpMagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 趋势行情中能捕捉较大波段利润，盈亏比合理
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
止损止盈参数可配置，风险边界明确
pros_en: Captures significant trend moves with a reasonable risk-reward ratio in trending markets
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide defined risk boundaries
cons: 震荡行情中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金自动调整风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Frequent MA crossover whipsaws in ranging markets generate false signals and consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management and cannot auto-adjust risk based on account equity
Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated trade entries on the same bar
improvements: 增加震荡过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在低趋势强度时减少交易频率
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理
添加新K线检测逻辑避免同一根K线重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce trade frequency during low-trend-strength conditions
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage
Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated entries on the same bar

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓
固定手数不随账户变化调整，存在过度交易风险
震荡市中频繁假信号可能造成持续亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same bar
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account changes, posing over-trading risk
Frequent false signals in ranging markets may cause sustained losses
